# packages/sdk/src/conversation

Turn assembly and the readable measurement layer for @prosodyai/sdk.

## Files

- `prosody.ts`: owns the readable measurement shape and the wire-to-product
  key maps. Anything exposing a measurement to a consumer goes through
  `prosodyFromState`, `prosodyStateFromWire`, `measurementFromState`, or
  `prosodyDeltaFromWire`.
- `turn-model.ts`: turn and step types; `ConversationTurn.prosody` is the
  per-turn measurement slot.
- `turn-builder.ts`: segments to turns, prosody attached by overlap.
- `transcript-merge.ts`: reducers for transcript and speaker updates.
- `speaker-resolution.ts`: live segment attribution.

## Contracts

- No wire field name leaves this directory except through the maps in
  `prosody.ts`.
- `Prosody` is `{ state, change }`: `state` is what was measured, `change` is
  the signed movement against the speaker's own baseline. Both share the same
  family shape: `intonation`, `stress`, `rhythm`, plus `tilt`.
- `ConversationTurn` carries `prosody?: Prosody | null`; the old `vocal`
  bundle with wire keys was removed.
